{{Top}}
[[File:Satellite-CRFG.png|thumb|right|A satellite.]]
A '''satellite''' was an object in orbit of another object, typically a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. They could be natural, in which case they were normally called [[Moon/Legends|moons]], or artificial, as in the case of such devices as [[Communications satellite]]s and [[De-Orbiting Kinetic Anti-emplacement Weapon|DOKAWs]]. [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was ringed with artificial satellites, many of which fell from orbit due to disrepair when the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] occupied the world.
